name: @olai/store
//exports: Two entries, and only the first is product. `./testlib` is the stamp blind-spot helper this package's own tests are written against, published so a package ABOVE can reach the same blind spot the same way — the alternative was @olai/ops growing a byte-identical copy, which is how the length INVARIANT inside it gets softened in one copy and not the other (@olai/format's own ./testlib says the same thing one floor down).
//dependencies: No workspace sibling, deliberately: the store is generic over its content and must not know what an outline is (https://github.com/juspay/oss.olai/blob/main/projects/olai/brainstorming/architecture.live-store.md). If @olai/format ever appears here, the seam has leaked.
//devDependencies: @effect/platform-node is the FileSystem the unit tests probe a real temp directory through. It is a DEV dependency and stays one: the store asks for the `FileSystem` service and never names an implementation, which is what lets the same probe run under the server's Node layer, a test's, and whatever the browser or a worker would bring. Pinned with the rest of the fleet — see the root package.json overrides.
